question: Does the one source-M32 strategy that is exact on all six production shapes stay within 3% of natural oneDNN when operator medians are weighted by the Qwen3.8 64-layer call graph at actual MTP1 decode row counts M=2c for c1 through c64?

basis.r124: Source-M32 passed every row, prefix, permutation, repeat, and padding identity check on all six shapes, but per-shape large-prefill gates rejected source integration.
basis.r134: M32 and M128 define different answers at all 90 tested shape/M points, so exact deployment must retain one arithmetic strategy rather than switch by M.
basis.practical_scope: Generation throughput is the promotion metric. Large-prefill latency remains visible and bounded separately; it is not mixed into the steady decode composition.

arms.A: natural oneDNN selection with GEMM_KERNEL unset
arms.B: the exact frozen source-M32 strategy in GEMM_KERNEL

composition.aggregation: For each shape/arm, take the median of the two run medians at each M. Multiply by call count and sum. Divide candidate sum by control sum.

gates.identity: Both B runs must retain one row-0 class, exact M512 prefixes, permutation invariance, repeat determinism, and padding exactness on every shape.
gates.decode: The weighted candidate/control ratio must be <=1.03 independently at every M in [2,4,8,16,32,64,128].
gates.prefill_visibility: Report weighted ratios at M168 and M256. A ratio >2.00 closes source integration as an unacceptable prompt-shape cost; values <=2.00 remain a disclosed TTFT tradeoff requiring endpoint measurement.
gates.health: No new Xe fault, reset, timeout, hang, coredump, or device loss.
gates.on_pass: Preregister and implement a narrow non-developer oneDNN source patch selecting exactly the M32 strategy only for the block-scaled FP8-weight/FP16-activation matmul contract; rerun dense M=1..512 operator identity before any server.
gates.on_failure: Do not build or launch the M32 source candidate. Preserve it only as the fastest exact correctness reference and proceed to an upstream-grade specialized kernel.
